title: Shared decision making in patients with rare hematologic and oncologic diseases
summary:
The aim of the study is to improve patient care in rare hematologic and oncologic diseases. Patients should be well informed about their diseases and treatment options so that they can actively participate in decision making and focus on their individual preferences. Physician and patient should meet at eye level in this process of shared decision making. 
Within this study different methods will be implemented to strengthen the shared decision making between patients and health care providers.
conditions: Shared Decision Making, myelofibrosis, paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria, aplastic anemia

interventions.name:
Implementation of Shared Decision Making (SDM) on basis of the S2C program in rare hematologic and oncologic diseases

The strengthening of shared decision making results by implementation of the following 4 modules:

1. Communication trainings for physicians
2. Qualification of nursing staff

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
diagnosis of primary myelofibrosis/post-ET-myelofibrosis/post-PV-myelofibrosis
diagnosis of paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria
diagnosis of aplastic anemia
Exclusion criteria:
linguistic barrier
